name: Arden Thatcher
plain_text:
Arden Thatcher
ENGINEERING MANAGER
arden.thatcher@example.com | (555) 0125-6936

PROFILE
Lean manufacturing professional with 20 years experience in lean manufacturing and continuous improvement. Highly skilled in all lean six sigma initiatives.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Engineering Manager | Quarry Solutions | Riverton, OH | 12/2015 to 08/2016
- Build the foundation for the engineering department at Airmate Company.
- Lead, develop, and mentor a group of engineers on daily tasks, project assignments, and project timelines.
- Standardized estimating process improving estimations from -30% to +5%.
- Implement engineering change control process.
Process Technician | Kelvin Group | Riverton, OH | 01/2009 to 12/2015
- Lead Lean/Continuous Improvement Projects to develop, standardize, and improve manufacturing processes.
- Approve engineering decision on material, dimensional specifications, processes and tolerances.
- Validate and verify new product designs.
- Participate and lead 3P events.
Quality Engineer Valve Value Stream | Calder Industries | Danville, IN | 03/2005 to 01/2009
- Handled all customer complaints and corrective actions.
- Proactively visited customers regarding quality or process improvements.
- Maintained APQP database which included PFEMA's, Control Plans, Product Profiles and all applicable work instructions.
- Performed capability studies on both machines and processes.
- Assisted with the development of new products and new processes.
Process Technician Valve Value Stream | Quarry Corporation | Selby, OR | 01/2003 to 01/2005
- Created and maintained value stream maps.
- Championed or led kaizen events derived from value stream maps Led multiple material and process cost saving initiatives.
- Created and controlled all standardized work including operational instructions and set up instructions.
- Assisted Applications and Manufacturing Engineering in new product development and launches.
Value Stream Group Leader | Vantage Partners | Clayton, MO | 01/1997 to 01/2003
- Led 50-70 hourly employees on day to day activities.
- Maintained and improved safety, morale, productivity, cost and quality daily.
- Led continuous improvement activities in productivity, quality and safety.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING
Applied Industrial Ergonomics | 2014
Lean Certification (Parker Lean Boot Camp I, II, and III) | 2014
EPA Certification | 2013
AWS Brazing Certification | 2011
Six Sigma Academy Greenbelt Training | 2007
Duggan and Associates *Value Stream Mapping | 2004
*Mixed Model Value Stream Mapping | 2006
Purdue University Poke-a-Yoke Certification | Indiana Tech | Grantham, NH | 2003

SKILLS
Continuous Improvement, database, Ergonomics, estimating, manufacturing processes, mentor, new product development, processes, quality, safety, Six Sigma
